prompt:

Preserve Japanese content, row order and states. Original Deputy grouped timesheet list: three people, dated rows, approved/pending/absent status and warning triangles with scheduled-time sublabels. Preserve exact dates/times and two warning triangles; no unrelated app shell. Keep all readable text, clean type, controls and alignment. No decorative color wash/glow. Do not redraw unrelated artwork or add elements. Preserve each badge's green/orange/red status text and matching outline. Preserve exact copy, all ten rows, all three headers, the two warning triangles, dates, times, current 640 x 653 frame, typography, sizes, positions, dividers, monograms and all other details. Do not change layout or type scale, and do not tint any badge interior.
